android.desc:
Close2Me: chat and call with people nearby, no internet needed

No signal? No data? No problem.

Close2Me is an offline chat app that connects your phone directly to the phones around you over Bluetooth. There’s no server, no account to set up with a carrier, and no Wi-Fi required. Just open the app, find people nearby, and start talking.

Chat without internet
Send messages to nearby phones even when you’re in a basement, on a hike, at a festival, or anywhere the network drops. Your messages go straight from phone to phone.

Voice calls over Bluetooth
Call someone close by like a walkie talkie, with no mobile data and no airtime.

Find people around you
Close2Me discovers nearby phones automatically using Bluetooth Low Energy, so you can connect in seconds without exchanging numbers.

Private by design
There’s no central server in the middle. Your conversations stay between your phone and the phone you’re talking to.

Morse code mode
Learn Morse code and use it to talk to a friend nearby. Tap out a message, translate it instantly, and practice together. (Keep this section only if the feature is live.)

Great for

Hiking, camping, and trips with poor coverage
Festivals, concerts, and crowded events where networks jam
Classrooms, campuses, and study groups
Travelling without roaming or data
Power cuts and emergencies when the network is down
Friends who want a fun, private way to chat in the same place

Why Close2Me

Works fully offline: chat and call with no internet
Peer-to-peer over Bluetooth, with no server
Fast nearby discovery
Clean, compact, easy-to-use design
Free to try
